content.text:
I removed a duplicated "Sunset Mug" card from `site/products.html`. The page now has six products, so the three-column grid fills two full rows instead of leaving Citrus Plant Pot alone on a third row.

There was only one commit, so I couldn't diff against the last change. I found the duplicate by reading the HTML and rendering the page at 1280px and 500px. The CSS looked fine. All 16 functional tests pass. I didn't re-render the page after the edit.

If "wrong" meant something else, such as spacing or colours, tell me and I'll look again. The "New" and "Sale" badges stick out past the card corners. That is set in `components.css` (`top: -10px; right: -10px`) and looks deliberate, so I left it.

STATUS: DONE
